title: FAI Skill Requires MCP v1
description: Validates the `requiresMcp` field on `SKILL.md` frontmatter. Declares which federated MCP areas a skill needs at invocation time. Read by the FrootAI engine pre-flight validator — refuses to run the skill if any area is unavailable.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [M0.4] of the FAI MCP Federation Kernel masterplan. Doctrine principle 2 — NO SILENT ATTACH: skills with non-empty requiresMcp trigger the trust gate before the skill body executes.
description: Flat array of federated MCP area slugs. Each slug must match the kebab-case area name registered by the kernel. Max 32 entries per skill (keeps trust prompts reasonable for `community` tier areas).
